# Code Review Report

## Review Summary

The PR successfully removes `src/main.py` and `src/setup.py`, completing the retirement of the legacy CLI entry points. This aligns with the transition to the OpenCode tool architecture and cleans up unused code. However, one issue remains: three shell configuration templates (`config.example.sh`, `configs/fast-prototype.sh`, and `configs/high-quality.sh`) still invoke the deleted `src/main.py`. These scripts will now fail with a file not found error instead of the previous clean `NotImplementedError` migration message. 

**Files Reviewed:** 2
**Findings:** 0 Critical, 1 Warning, 0 Suggestion
